s7002_PP_o2: Careful! 5:15 is a real time in the message, but it is the time Ali brings the ball. The question asks about when the game starts. Hint: look for the words "The game starts at". Read the question again and try once more: What time does the game start?
s7005_PP_o2: Yes, 2:15 is right! Quarter past means 15 minutes after the hour, so quarter past two is 2:15. Now try a new one. Read: "A: Meet at half past four. B: No, quarter to five is better. A: OK." What time do they meet? Write it as a clock time.
s7008_PP_o2: Yes, 2:15 is right! Quarter past means 15 minutes after two. Now try a harder one. Read: "A: Is the film at seven? B: No, it is at half past seven." What time is the film? Write it as a clock time.
s7011_PP_o2: Yes, "a" is right! Doctor starts with a consonant sound, so we use a. Now try the next one. Write a, an or the: "I bought a book. ___ book is very good." Answer with only the missing word.
s7014_PP_o2: Yes, "We usually have lunch." is right! Usually goes before the main verb, have. Now try the last one. Put in order: "often / my aunt / tea / makes"
s7017_PP_o2: Yes, "She" is right! Your grandmother is a woman, so we use she. Now try a new one. Complete: "This is my grandfather. ___ is seventy years old."
s7020_PP_o2: Yes, "is" is the missing word! Now write the whole sentence with a capital letter at the start and a full stop at the end. Then add one more sentence about your teacher. Use is or has.
s7023_PP_o2: Yes, "The" is right! We already talked about the book ("I bought a book"), so the second time we say the book. Now try a new one. Write a, an or the: "We saw ___ elephant at the zoo." Answer with only the missing word.
s7026_PP_o2: Yes, "can't" is right! I never learned means I am not able to, so we use can't. Now try a new one. Complete: "My brother ___ swim. He is a champion." Write can or can't.

s7035_PP_o2: Good try, but "go" is not right here. "Last weekend" is finished, so we need the past form. Go is an irregular verb, so we do not add -ed. Hint: the past form starts with w and has four letters. Try again: "Last weekend I ___ to the beach."
s7038_PP_o2: Yes, "some" is right! Rice is something we cannot count, so we use some. Now try a new one. Complete: "I'd like ___ cheese sandwich, please." Write a or some.
s7041_PP_o2: Yes, watches is right! Watch ends in -ch, so with she we add -es, not just -s. Now try a new one. Write the correct form: "The baby ___ (cry) at night." Answer with only the verb.
s7044_PP_o2: Yes, "I am happy because it is my birthday." is right! Because gives the reason for the feeling. Now make your own sentence. Finish this: "I am tired because ..."
s7047_PP_o2: Good! In a cafe, "a coffee" means one cup, so "Can I have a coffee, please?" is fine. "Some coffee" is also correct. Now a new task. You are hungry. Order a sandwich with "I'd like ..." and add please.
s7050_PP_o2: Yes, had is right! Have becomes had, and we do not say "haved". Now try a new one. Write the past form of 'see': "Yesterday I ___ my friend at the market."

s7056_PP_o2: That is okay. Let me help. We say: "Do you have this jacket in small?" We use this jacket (not a jacket) and the word in before the size. Now you write it yourself: ask the shop assistant for this jacket in small.
